title: B2 Level Final Exam
description: Test your knowledge of advanced tenses (Past Perfect Continuous, Future Perfect Continuous), Mixed Conditionals, Passive with modals, Inversion, Participle clauses, Ellipsis, Subjunctive, Perfect infinitive/gerund, Complex conjunctions, Modal verbs in the past (advanced), Causative (advanced), Formal vs informal, Emphatic structures (advanced), Concessive clauses (advanced), Preferences (advanced), Advanced phrasal verbs, Advanced vocabulary

exercises.instruction: Fill in the past perfect continuous form.

items.sentence: She ___ (work) for that company for 20 years when she retired.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the mixed conditional forms.

items.sentence: If I ___ (study) harder, I would have a better job now.
If you should need any assistance, contact us. → Should ___
items.correct: you need any assistance, contact us

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentence using the subjunctive form.

items.sentence: It is essential that he ___ (arrive) on time.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the perfect infinitive or perfect gerund.

items.sentence: He loves sports, ___ his wife prefers reading.

exercises.instruction: Rewrite the sentence in a formal style.

items.sentence: I need your help. → I ___ your assistance.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the correct phrasal verb.

items.sentence: I can't ___ up with this noise any longer!
She ___ up with a brilliant idea.
He ___ away with cheating on the test.

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentence with the correct word (B2 vocabulary).

items.sentence: The crew had to ___ the sinking ship.
She is a leading ___ on climate change.

items.source: К следующему месяцу я проработаю здесь 10 лет.
items.target: By next month, I will have been working here for 10 years.

items.source: Что бы ни случилось, не теряй надежды.

items.target: She came up with a brilliant idea.
